The '''Tandon sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Harlov Jarnek]]. It contained the [[Spirador system/Legends|Spirador system]].
